concept: Extreme close-up photograph of a triangular glass prism on a matte black surface, refracting a single beam of white light into violet and teal spectral bands. Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c, 100mm macro lens, f/8, ISO 100. Studio lighting: single focused beam from left, otherwise complete darkness. The prism is crystal clear with razor-sharp edges catching the light. The refracted colors cast onto the black surface in clean geometric bands. Minimal, scientific, elegant. The photograph should feel like it belongs in a Wallpaper Magazine editorial about optics. No text, no other objects. Pure glass, pure light, pure precision.

creative_direction.thesis: An extreme macro photograph capturing a triangular glass prism meticulously refracting a single white light beam into distinct violet and teal spectral bands on an absolute matte black surface, epitomizing scientific elegance and minimalist design.

three_anchors.visual_hook: Extreme macro close-up of a razor-sharp glass prism dramatically refracting vivid spectral light against an absolute black void.
three_anchors.emotional_core: A sense of pristine scientific beauty, controlled precision, and sophisticated minimalist elegance.
three_anchors.cultural_anchor: Editorial aesthetic of Wallpaper Magazine, high-end minimalist product photography, elevated scientific illustration.

creative_direction.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a perfectly clear, equilateral triangular glass prism, its razor-sharp edges catching light, positioned centrally on an absolute matte black (#000000) surface. The background is pure, infinite inky blackness. A single, intensely focused beam of white light strikes the prism's top-left face at a precise 45-degree angle, causing crisp refraction. Two distinct, parallel geometric bands of vivid violet (#8A2BE2) and brilliant teal (#008080) light are cast onto the matte black surface directly beneath the prism's base. The remainder of the scene is in complete darkness. CAMERA: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 100mm macro lens, f/8 aperture, ISO 100. COLOR TEMPERATURE: Clinical, cool. MOOD/ATMOSPHERE: Scientific precision, minimalist elegance, controlled optical phenomenon, abstract beauty, stark. STYLE REFERENCE: Wallpaper Magazine editorial photography, minimalist luxury product photography, high-fidelity scientific illustration.
creative_direction.negative_elements: Vague colors, soft focus, blurry edges, additional objects, reflections, dust, fingerprints, text, busy background, warm tones, diffused light, any elements distracting from the prism and refracted light.
creative_direction.art_direction_notes: This prompt focuses on hyper-realistic macro photography to highlight the intricate beauty of optical physics. The extreme close-up and precise lighting transform a scientific phenomenon into a luxury aesthetic, aligning with the clean, sophisticated visual language of publications like Wallpaper Magazine. The stark contrast between the absolute black and the razor-sharp, vibrant spectral bands creates a powerful, iconic visual mark, suitable for a 'logo' type image through its simplicity and strong graphic impact.
